narrative: The west window with the candle out. The close beyond the glass is black. The church porch does not show. No moon. A dark wick and a thumb of cold tallow on the candlestick. No hand. No face. No reflection.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Pinched the flame and turned from the window.

entities.name: the penny almanac
entities.context: In photo: The close, with the candle out
